in_arabic.name: Aana
in_arabic.long_meaning: Aana هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. Derived from the Arabic root 'anā', meaning 'to hope' or 'to wish'. In Islamic tradition, Aana is a name of the beloved Prophet Muhammad's (pbuh) daughter, Fatima (ra). It is also used as a term of endearment and a symbol of love and devotion.
